changelog:
- Modern Luxury UI Architecture: Arc & Safari 18 inspired dark obsidian aesthetic with subtle ambient radial illumination.
- Dynamic Command Bar: Floats centered in the middle of the Start Page and glides down to bottom (or top) smoothly upon search or navigation.
- Modern Squircle Command Card: Upgraded from curvy oval pill to 14dp squircle with subtle crisp border while preserving all tabs, three-dots menu, voice search, reader view, and multi-engine selector features.
- Modern Feature Buttons: Geometric vector SVG squircle buttons for Favorites, History, AdShield, and Settings (no basic emojis).
- Ghost Mode & Truth Pulse: Header capsules with real-time toggle status and pulsing neon Truth Pulse hub trigger.
- 2x2 Speed Dial Cards: Brand logo squircles with clean bold title and domain subtitle.
